Scope: sewage, storm water (to the ponds), irrigation and potable water networks, 13.8 kV medium-voltage cables, street lighting, telecom ducts and cables, internal and external roads with asphalt and sidewalks, the potable water and TSE pump stations, three lift stations and a mosque. Contract value SAR 560 million excluding VAT, 36 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-days (the labour units of the P6 schedule). No weekly report workbook was uploaded this week, only the P6 update of 09-Nov-2026, so the figures were computed from it on the same basis as last week's P6 export (159,298 baseline man-days): 54.11% actual against 54.57% planned, 0.46% behind, SPI 0.99. The project gained 0.66% this week against 0.60% planned.

The P6 update finishes the project 6 days after the contract date, and most networks earned nothing in two weeks. The 09-Nov-2026 update finishes the project on 21-Mar-2028 against the contract date of 15-Mar-2028 (19-Mar-2028 in the 26-Oct update). The critical path runs through the TSE pump station: 122 of the 164 open zero-float activities are there, 31 in landscape and 9 in roads. This week's gain came almost entirely from roads (631 man-days), street lighting (215) and earthworks for roads (105). The storm, sewage, potable water and irrigation networks, the Jeddah-Jizan link road, the mosque and lift station 2 earned nothing between 26-Oct and 09-Nov-2026, and their finish dates moved by the same 14 days. Roads (38.4% against 56.0%), street lighting (41.3% against 71.5%) and landscape (0% against 15.9%) are the weakest areas.

Method for 09-Nov-2026: each activity is weighted by its labour units in the revised baseline (009-RVSD03-REV02-1, 159,298 man-days); actual progress uses each activity's physical % complete in the update, and planned progress spreads the units evenly by day between the baseline start and finish. The same method reproduces the weekly report's P6 export for 26-Oct-2026 (53.23% actual, 53.27% planned) and its planned 53.97% for 02-Nov-2026. Last week's summary figure (58.70%) is on another basis and was not updated this week.

Network finish dates moved two weeks in two weeks. The TSE, sewage and storm network finishes each moved 14 days between the two updates, as long as the time that passed, because those networks earned no progress. The project finish moved 2 days to 21-Mar-2028, and the potable water pump station lost 8 days of float (14 to 6) and now finishes after its baseline date. Float on interim milestones is measured to project finish, so late network milestones still show hundreds of days.

Procurement of key materials

Share of the total quantity delivered to site. Source: MODON supplier follow-up sheet updated 09-Nov-2026 (no quantities changed since 02-Nov-2026).

Station systems not yet approvedCCTV, public address, access control, fire alarm and data and telephone systems are still listed as not approved (supplier, samples, shop drawings). The note changed this week from "to be resubmitted" to "purchase order being issued"; the required delivery date is 26-May-2027.
Items in manufacturePanels and substations due end of November 2026; fuel system 15-Nov-2026; water hammer vessels 30-Nov-2026; altitude valves complete by early December; cranes to start delivery within two weeks; penstocks (6) in January 2027. SCADA parts delivery has started, with the full system on site in January 2027. The remaining station pumps are due within a week.

Data notes

  • This week's upload has no weekly report workbook: the archive 009-wpr80 -09-11-26.zip holds only the P6 update. Physical progress was computed from it as described under the S-curve. The manpower, cost and invoicing sections are left out, and safety statistics are missing, because no file this week gives them.
  • The P6 update has a data date of 09-Nov-2026, but no activity has an actual start or finish after 02-Nov-2026, although physical % complete rose by 1,043 man-days since 02-Nov.
  • The phase table this week is on the P6 basis; last week's phase table used the weekly report summary, whose planned and actual values differ (for example storm network 74.50% planned and 85.77% actual there, 78.65% and 90.55% here).
  • The 3-week look-ahead file (3 Weeks.pdf) is empty (0 bytes).
  • In the MODON supplier sheet the station systems are still marked "not approved" while the note says the purchase order is being issued. The pumps note says 10 remain, but 29 − 18 = 11. The fuel system is still due 15-Nov-2026.
  • The shop drawing log totals 3,551 drawings (1,189 code A, 2,285 code B); last week's weekly report gave 3,799 (1,197 A, 2,307 B). The material submittal log shows "Submitted 189%" for stations and mosque and "Submitted 100%" for infrastructure with 27 of 30 submitted.
  • The risk dashboard shows 4 open risks (3 in its category table) while the log lists 5. Issue ID#04 is filed under contract JDH3-02-010. Scores do not follow the log's rule (score = probability × impact); for example risk ID#02 is 4 × 4 but scored 4.
  • The procurement tracker's Info sheet is still dated 15-Jun-2026 and reports cost-based progress, which is not used here. The contractor's master log FIR sheets stop at 2,000 rows in the converted file, so FIR counts are not shown.
